claim: GDT734 assigns a finite twenty-whole map of heated, dried, cooled and soaked preparation states, taking and measuring actions, powder and woody plant material, and indexed shares. Okeeey and lkeeey retain strong-heat end states; cheeo complete drying; shky a hot-moist beginning; polaiin powder value III; and shdar a soaked measured share I. The old qofchedy take/dry/finish instruction is retained as historical composition explicitly withdrawn by GDT766, not restored as a current reading. Each exact whole keeps its original working default, action allowance, composition classification, counterevidence and open slots. The nine compositional, five role-constrained and six learned classifications are internal working judgments; a unique dictionary split and repeated occurrence do not confirm the meanings or release prefix/suffix values. This twenty-whole map is separate from the nineteen-form role matrix and the active-whole editorial renderer.
